recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless a future CDS or infrastructure decision changes Library.content summary behavior or Attachment summary rules.
issue_request: FHIR-19256 was Published/Persuasive for the FHIR-core Library resource. It requested marking Library.content as a summary element so clients can display content metadata in Library lists without retrieving full embedded content; the resolution explicitly relied on Attachment.data not being a summary element.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#6898f7fb27. Commit 6898f7fb27963bc638709c80faac396b1272d773 applied the request in the historical source/library/library-spreadsheet.xml by changing the Library.content Summary column from blank to Y. Later source refactoring moved Library into source/library/structuredefinition-Library.xml and preserved isSummary=true.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes library=Library, confirming the current Library StructureDefinition source is in build scope. The current Library.content element is type Attachment and has isSummary=true, while the ElementDefinition summary documentation still lists Attachment.data as not marked as summary. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision for this issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative source already satisfies the published Jira decision and preserves the intended metadata-only summary behavior.
